scope: In-app dictation and read-aloud in the translator and assistant, plus owner checks of normal-browser speech input and local dictionary read-aloud

verified_wiring.recording_and_attachment_consumers: Previously checked in Documents & audio and terminology editing; see audio-verification.json.

unit_and_component_tests.speech_apis: Synthetic recognition events and speech-synthesis fixtures; no physical microphone or audible output.
unit_and_component_tests.translation_and_chat_responses: Mocked API responses for control-flow verification, not a new real Gemini acceptance run.
additional_cases: Language selection, direction changes and stale recognition callbacks
Permission, unavailable service, missing microphone, network, no-speech and unsupported-language errors
Explicit retry after a recognition error
Audio focus and recognition cleanup on unmount/navigation
French/English voice selection and finished/stale speech events
A 4,001-character transcript is bounded to 4,000 with an explicit notice
Typed text survives a speech-service error and can still be submitted
Spoken source text becomes the translation request payload
Spoken assistant text becomes the chat request payload
Read-aloud sends the returned translation/reply text to the speech engine
Turning automatic reply reading off while a request is pending prevents late autoplay

automated_validation.editor_diagnostics: The initial generic diagnostic tool reported no errors; see editor_configuration_follow_up for subsequently reproduced editor-project errors and their fix.
automated_validation.editor_test_discovery: Unavailable; the repository Vitest command was used.

editor_configuration_follow_up.reproduction: Open the test file through a fresh TypeScript language-server session, query its default project, then request synchronous semantic diagnostics.
editor_configuration_follow_up.cause: The application tsconfig excludes tests, and the custom-named tsconfig.test.json was not automatically discovered by the editor. Its shared setup importing the jest-dom Vitest matcher types was therefore missing from the inferred project.
editor_configuration_follow_up.fix: Add frontend/tests/tsconfig.json extending ../tsconfig.test.json, so editor discovery and the existing command-line check use the same test configuration.

owner_live_checks.name: French dictation in the translator
owner_live_checks.instruction: Use your voice with French selected as the source, without submitting a translation.
owner_live_checks.owner_confirmation: Yes, my spoken words appear correctly

owner_live_checks.name: Spoken-input AI translation
owner_live_checks.instruction: Use the same test phrase, turn private terminology and reference dictionary grounding off, leave AI enabled and press Translate once.
owner_live_checks.owner_confirmation: A quota or rate-limit error appears

owner_live_checks.name: Read-aloud without AI
owner_live_checks.instruction: Open dictionary entry tchop in the translator, leave the reference dictionary enabled, turn approved terminology and AI off, translate locally, then press Read aloud.

changes.test_fixtures: Added reusable typed speech recognition/synthesis fixtures following the existing isolated media-test pattern.
changes.test_coverage: Added regression coverage for both shared speech hooks and their translator/assistant consumers.
changes.app_behavior: No missing audio connection or production defect was demonstrated; existing explicit review/submission and speech-service errors are preserved.
changes.documentation: Documented the in-app voice workflow and separated working speech controls from AI quota availability.

limitations: The full live spoken-input to AI-translation to spoken-result workflow is not cleared: the owner-observed AI request hit a quota/rate limit.
Owner confirmations cover French speech input and English read-aloud of a local dictionary result, not every recognition language, installed voice or browser.
Assistant dictation, manual reply reading and opt-in automatic reply reading passed component tests; a fresh real Gemini assistant conversation was not run.
French read-aloud and Francanglais/Pidgin pronunciation quality were not manually certified.
Browser speech-service connectivity and installed voices remain environment dependencies; API presence alone does not prove either works.
The separately reproduced VS Code embedded media-playback limitation is not fixed or reclassified as success.
Cloud media transcription/OCR, the remaining translation directions and public deployment are not certified by these speech checks.
